cards.name: Bishop of Wings
cards.oracleText:
Whenever an Angel you control enters, you gain 4 life.
Whenever an Angel you control dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.

cards.name: Bishop of the Bloodstained
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent loses 1 life for each Vampire you control.

cards.name: Bishop of Binding
cards.oracleText:
When this creature enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield.
Whenever this creature attacks, target Vampire gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the power of the exiled card.

cards.name: Bygone Bishop
cards.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value 3 or less, investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

cards.name: Bishop of Rebirth
cards.oracleText:
Vigilance
Whenever this creature attacks, you may return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
